title: Wyoming storage shed turns out to be 140-year-old Chinese laundry

title: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific ocean conservation

The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: Michigan family lost $194,400 home over $2,242 tax bill; Supreme Court steps in

A family in Michigan, burdened with a $2,241.93 tax debt, faced foreclosure despite their home being valued at $194,400. With the auction yielding only $76,008, the family is rightfully awarded the remaining $73,766.07, reinforcing constitutional guidelines for future tax sales.

title: San Antonio oyster shells recycled to rebuild Gulf reefs and marine habitat

The South Texas Coastal Initiative sends collected shells to the Sink Your Shucks program, where they are reused for reef restoration. With about 100,000 oysters consumed during Fiesta Oyster Bake weekend, organizers are seeking $150,000 annually.

title: PSU banks lift ATM charges in view of strike
content:
PSBs, RRBs waive ATM fees ahead of 3-day strike

NEW DELHI: Public sector banks and regional rural banks have announced their decision to waive ATM charges to ensure hassle-free cash withdrawal by their customers from Sept 28-30 due to the strike called by employee unions. Besides, all branches of state-run banks and RRB will remain open on Sunday as the unions have called a three-day strike starting Monday. "Withdrawals from other bank ATMs can be made without charges from 26th to 30th Sept," Indian Bank said. HDFC said its branches will remain open Sunday and it will be business as usual during the strike. Govt earlier asked for payment of salaries and pension to retired personnel ahead of time to avoid the impact of strike. TNN

title: ‘Gyanesh Kumar deserves at least Padma Bhushan’: Bengal BJP chief backs CEC
content: BJP chief says he deserves 'at least the Padma Bhushan' for overseeing peaceful elections . he also took a swipe at Congress leader Rahul Gandhi . the BJP leader said voters were able to cast their ballots without fear .

title: In a first, waste plastic mixed with bitumen in pilot test section of NH-44
content: govt has used waste plastic as a wet mix with bitumen to lay a bituminous highway stretch . a pilot test section was laid on the main carriageway of NH-44 in Jhansi . officials said the technology has potential to reduce conventional bitsumen consumption by around 4%, lowering demand for a material India largely imports to meet domestic requirements .

title: NDA unease over EC-SIR row? 3 BJP allies seek answers as oppn turns up heat
content: three BJP allies urge the Election Commission of India to issue a clearer response . a report concerning chief election commissioner gyanesh Kumar surfaced on friday . the BJP president was the first NDA ally to urge the ECI to dispel "misgivings in the minds of the people"

title: 'Compromised PM does it again': Cong after bail to US national held in terror case
content: the release of US national Matthew Aaron vanDyke has triggered a political row . he was arrested by the NIA in a case involving an alleged terror conspiracy linked to Myanmar-based ethnic armed groups . the accused had entered India and travelled to restricted areas in the northeast before crossing into Myanmar .

title: 2022 Rajouri IED blast: Police file chargesheet against 4
content: two migrant labourers were injured in the explosion below Jaganaloo bridge in Rajouri district on April 19 that year . three of the accused are already behind bars . their handler, Mohammed Qasim alias Salman, conspired the attack and remained in direct contact with Talib Hussain Shah .

title: Watch: PM Modi grooves at a 'bhajan clubbing' event in Delhi
content: the prime minister attended a 'bhajan clubbing' at deen dayal Upadhyay Park . he can be seen listening to the Bhajans while playing the headless tambourine . the PM also waved to the gathered audience as he arrived for the event .

title: On UNGA margins, India & Liberia set up sailors' safety body
content: india teamed up with liberia to establish a group of friends on safety and security of shipping and seafarers . foreign minister says actions that disrupt maritime commerce and cost innocent lives are simply indefensible . "we are here to not highlight this dangerous trend but to urge the international community to close ranks," he says .

title: Lawyers move SC, AG for action on poll panel chief
content: a supreme court lawyer has filed a petition in court seeking his criminal prosecution . the petition filed in SC said action needed to be taken against the chief election commissioner . a contempt petition was filed against him for his "unilateral, unauthorised, and illegal decisions"

title: Pakistan PM draws ‘red line’ over Mecca at UN, defends Saudi-Türkiye defence pact
content: shehbaz Sharif condemns attacks by the Houthis against the kingdom of Saudi Arabia . he also warns against any threat to the safety and sanctity of Mecca . the 81st u.n. general assembly has condemned the attacks .

title: 3 BJP allies say EC must clear air, can't lose people's trust
content: EC seeks clarification to dispel public doubts . he says he did not intend to "defend what is a constitutional body" but wanted EC to address concerns among people . "if questions are raised about its conduct, it is the responsibility of EC, especially the chief election commissioner," he said .

title: Months after OSM row, government appoints new CBSE chairperson
content:
Senior bureaucrat Mandeep K Bhandari

NEW DELHI: Senior bureaucrat Mandeep K Bhandari was appointed CBSE chairperson, months after the rollout of On-Screen Marking (OSM)-based evaluation and post-result processes triggered complaints over alleged answer-sheet mix-ups, portal glitches, payment failures and delays in re-evaluation. Bhandari, a 2001-batch IAS officer of AGMUT cadre, is currently principal secretary to J&K lieutenant governor. The appointments committee of the Cabinet approved his appointment, personnel department said. His was among 10 transfers and postings effected by govt Friday. On June 2, govt removed CBSE chairperson Rahul Singh and secretary Himanshu Gupta and ordered an inquiry into procurement of the digital evaluation system. In other postings, Vipin Kumar, AAI chairperson, was appointed additional secretary, rural development. Anand Singh will be additional secretary, economic affairs department.

End of Article
